title: Drive offhand construction after validated item/mapping — next-analysis backlog
release_scope: No frozen source, tests, docs, package or build modified. These are additional static failure boundaries, not a reproduced diagnosis of the user's current Final Form crash.

findings.Finding: The generic player constructor initializes weapon slots+3424/+3432 to0. For form1..6 or10,3A7A40 resolves the offhand again and calls3D7C70. Slot1 is published only after3EF750 returns; an earlier resource/content fault leaves construction incomplete.
findings.Limitations: A nonzero item does not itself prove the asynchronous constructor will finish. Existing repair removes the known empty-item path.

findings.Finding: The weapon allocation is3088 bytes via152430. On null it sets RBX0, stores0 in the slot, then unconditionally calls3C8440 with RCX=0x158.3C8440 writes atRCX+48; the allocation failure branch is an immediate native fault path.
findings.Limitations: Static branch proof only, not an observed out-of-memory failure. Pre-Begin readable/heap-size checks cannot guarantee a later successful allocation.

findings.Finding: Resource acquisition searches the filename/group registry via39E1E0. A missing result merely runs a diagnostic traversal; the code then callsstrstr(record+4), incrementsWORD(record+2), and returnsQWORD(record+88) without rejecting null.
findings.Limitations: The native loader normally creates these records. Name-table validation is not equivalent to a valid active loaded record; null payload and null record are distinct cases.

findings.Finding: The unrecognized six-instruction callback range39DEE0..39DEF3 writes record+1=255 for a null resource result; otherwise it calls39E900.39E340 keeps yielding for active records whose phase is neither0 nor3. Thus this explicit load failure can wait indefinitely.
findings.Limitations: This path supports a loading hang, not a claim that every missing file immediately crashes. No game test was performed.

findings.Finding: 3EF750 calls3D7620(parent,hand). The helper obtains selected form object BYTE+7 via3B5C10, uses3EAAE0 bsearch, then reads signedWORD(row+4+2*hand) with no null check. Offhand usesrow+6.
findings.Limitations: Missing row is a direct invalid-access path. The admitted joint encoding/range still needs validation against actual parent model content; do not assume every negative value is invalid.

findings.Finding: 3F4C30 loads first system BAR type2/tag sklt and installs it via3EAB20 at2AE5798. Table has8-byte header;DWORD+4 count,8-byte rows, DWORD key at0 and two signedWORD hand joints at4/6.
findings.Limitations: Bound table count and rows by the owning BAR entry/allocation, not merely readable process pages. Duplicate/unsorted keys do not support a deterministic mirrored lookup.

findings.Finding: An empty wmst name skips only motion binding and attachment, not allocation of the weapon actor. Nonempty names perform lookup ofobj/name.mset, store the payload atweapon+344, link motion, look up the parent joint and attach.
findings.Limitations: Current PlanFormWeapon already rejects empty offhand wmst names. Missing nonempty file, corrupt contents and missing skeleton-row remain separate assumptions.

findings.Finding: Base weapon actor construction resolves MDLX and other resources through3E63D0→3E6120, then parses the MDLX with3A6420.3A6420 readscontainer+4 immediately. Missing BAR payload therefore cannot be treated as safe merely because an object-table name exists.
findings.Limitations: Some individual model BAR entries are optional in native code. A blanket requirement for every entry type would reject valid resources; mandatory dependencies must follow actual consumers.

findings.Finding: For a nonnull selected motion child,3C8A40 consumes nested BAR type9 and16 entries and dereferences their entry offsets without a robust missing-entry branch. A malformed selected motion can fault after a valid outer MSET name/payload.
findings.Limitations: A completely null motion source is handled in several motion selectors, so absence alone is not universally fatal. Prove the actual selected motion and validate its inner spans/content; arbitrary motion IDs must not be forced.

findings.Finding: 3E0660 recursively schedules each resolved weapon object and all four nonzero ushort object dependencies at+88..94. It has no visited-set/cycle guard.
findings.Limitations: Retail assets are assumed well formed. Cyclic modded dependency rows can cause recursion failure even if the initial weapon model row/name is valid; no such corrupt asset was observed.

findings.Finding: Drive coroutine preloads through3E0630/3E0660, yields through39D460/39E340, then creates the player through405030→3A7A40.3E0CC0 reads the live form weapon record in both preload and construction paths rather than a captured item snapshot.
findings.Limitations: A foreign equipment/table write between those stages can change the constructor inputs. Native menus and this trainer's transition guards normally prevent ordinary in-game edits; arbitrary other mods are not serialized.

guard_candidates.contract: Use system BAR RVA2AE5E50. Select first type2/tag0x746C6B73; decoded entry pointer must equalRVA2AE5798. Verify entry inside complete owner allocation using the same validated allocation/BAR pattern as went/wmst. Require header8 and 8+count*8 within entry size, strictly ordered DWORD keys, exact key=selected form object BYTE+7, read signed offhand joint fromrow+6.
guard_candidates.status: Directly implementable structural check, subject to fixtures and review. Joint value vs model skeleton still open.

guard_candidates.contract: Derive the weapon ID from went; derive obj/name.mdlx and wmst offhand obj/name.mset; include object-based supplementary resource names and recursive4×ushort dependencies+88..94 exactly as3E0660. Verify actual effective content after mod/archive resolution, bounded containers and no recursion cycles.
guard_candidates.status: Useful but requires an effective file-resolution contract; checking only retail files while mods override them is insufficient.

guard_candidates.candidate: Separate package presence from loaded readiness
guard_candidates.contract: Loaded registry headRVA29F33C8,120-byte nodes: filename+4, phaseBYTE+1, refcountWORD+2, flagsDWORD+68, groupDWORD+72, spanQWORD+80, payloadQWORD+88, priorQWORD+96, packed nextDWORD+112. Mirror exact first-match filename/group semantics. A future synchronous preflight can inspect existing active records; not-yet-loaded targets need controlled loading and a validated native-stage boundary.
guard_candidates.status: Cannot require every target already loaded before normal Drive or all newly used forms would be rejected. Current command does native asynchronous loading.

guard_candidates.candidate: Validate actual resolved BAR/MSET and parent attachment metadata
guard_candidates.contract: Require active relevant records, successful readiness, nonzero bounded payloads, valid BAR spans, sklt row/parent joint compatibility, and actual selected motion inner type9/16 structure. Abort at a validated pre-constructor boundary before native consumers touch invalid data.
guard_candidates.status: Boundary/hook/lifetime contract not implemented or authorized here; a post-constructor observer is too late for immediate faults.

guard_candidates.contract: A3088-byte weapon allocation and3608-byte player allocation occur later in the native coroutine. A current heap reading cannot guarantee later allocation success or rollback. Any recovery must handle the native constructor failure point safely rather than relying on pre-Begin free-byte estimates.
guard_candidates.status: Inherently later; no safe fallback/rollback hook has been implemented or claimed.

open_questions: Validate signed joint encoding against the actual form model skeleton and attachment consumer; do not invent a>=0 constraint.
Derive and validate all model/animation-specific content dependencies without treating optional native BAR entries as mandatory.
Implement effective modded archive/file resolution and distinguish missing, replaced and malformed assets.
Identify a reversible native pre-constructor loading checkpoint if runtime content validation is pursued; do not simply hard-abort an active fiber.
No reproduced current-build Final Form failure or runtime stack is available. These findings do not establish which remaining failure path caused the user's latest crash.
